name: ARKAMIN 150 Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About ARKAMIN 150 TABLET

ARKAMIN 150 Tablet is used to lower high blood pressure and manage hypertension in affected individuals. It contains Clonidine, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antihypertensives that work by relaxing the blood vessels, which makes the heart pump blood more efficiently around the body, resulting in lowered blood pressure and thereby managing hypertension in affected individuals.

ARKAMIN 150 Tablet is not recommended for use in patients allergic to clonidine. It is also not recommended for use in patients with the rare hereditary condition of galactose intolerance and/or heart diseases (such as heart failure or a slow or irregular heart rate).

Before taking ARKAMIN 150 Tablet, inform your doctor if you have Raynaud’s phenomenon (a condition marked by decreased blood flow to the fingers and toes), depression, constipation, altered sensation, diabetes, liver, and/or kidney problems.

ARKAMIN 150 Tablet is not recommended for use during pregnancy or in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use by breast-feeding women.

ARKAMIN 150 Tablet is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 60 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ARKAMIN 150 Tablet are dizziness, dry mouth, tiredness, headache, constipation, nausea, and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How to use ARKAMIN 150 TABLET

Take ARKAMIN 150 Tablet as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: ARKAMIN 150 Tablet is not recommended for use by pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
ARKAMIN 150 Tablet is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as it may pass through milk. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy, dizzy, or have some disturbances of vision after taking the ARKAMIN 150 Tablet.
Avoid consuming alcohol while taking ARKAMIN 150 Tablet, as it may alter the effect of the medicine.
ARKAMIN 150 Tablet should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
ARKAMIN Tablet should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not take ARKAMIN Tablet if you are allergic to Clonidine and/or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.
ARKAMIN Tablet is not recommended for use in patients with problems such as heart failure or a slow or irregular heart rate. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
ARKAMIN Tablet is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
ARKAMIN Tablet should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged over 60 years). Consult your doctor before taking.

Others

ARKAMIN Tablet is not recommended for use if you:

Have rare hereditary condition of galactose intolerance

Before taking ARKAMIN Tablet, inform your doctor if you:

Have signs of Raynaud’s phenomenon (a condition marked by decreased blood flow to the fingers and toes), such as cold fingers or toes
Have or ever had depression
Have constipation
Have an altered sensation (nerve disorder) that causes your hands and feet to feel different
Have low blood pressure while standing up
Have intolerance or difficulty digesting certain sugars (such as lactose)
Have diabetes
Have signs of phaeochromocytoma (a rare tumour of the adrenal gland) such as high blood pressure, headaches, and heavy sweating
Have a stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-drug interactions:

Antihistamines (Ex. brompheniramine, diphenhydramine)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen)
Antidepressants (Ex. imipramine or mirtazapine)
Antipsychotics (Ex. chlorpromazine)
Cardiovascular agents (Ex. atenolol, verapamil, diltiazem hydrochloride, captopril, lisinopril, and digoxin)
Diuretics (Ex. furosemide)
Alpha blockers (Ex. prazosin or doxazosin)
Vasodilators (Ex. diazoxide or sodium nitroprusside)

Over dosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of the ARKAMIN Tablet, consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are a slow heartbeat, drowsiness, temporary breathlessness, dizziness, weakness, lethargy, feeling cold, vomiting, looking pale, an irregular heartbeat, and a coma.

name: GENTROL 2.5 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About GENTROL 2.5 TABLET

GENTROL 2.5 TABLET contains Prazosin which belongs to the group of medicines called Alpha-Blockers. It is used for managing high blood pressure (hypertension), heart failure, benign prostatic hyperplasia (enlarged prostate), and Raynaud’s disease (painful cold fingers).

Controlling high blood pressure (hypertension) lowers the risk of heart attack or stroke. This medicine may be prescribed alone or alongside other medicines. Take it regularly and follow the dose and duration prescribed by your doctor. Since high blood pressure usually has no symptoms, continue taking it even if you feel well.

The most common side effects of this medicine include weakness, dizziness, headache, nausea, palpitations (unusual heart beating), drowsiness, fatigue, and light headedness. Most of these effects tend to improve as your body adjusts to the medicine. It may also cause blood pressure to drop too low, especially when starting the medicine. Your doctor can offer guidance to help reduce or manage these side effects effectively.

If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Inform your doctor if you have a history of heart failure, liver disease, kidney disease, or if you are scheduled for cataract eye surgery. Your blood pressure will be monitored regularly during management to ensure safe and effective use.

mechanismOfAction:
How GENTROL 2.5 TABLET Works
How GENTROL 2.5 TABLET Works in the Body

GENTROL 2.5 TABLET works by relaxing the muscles in blood vessel walls and around the prostate gland. This leads to widened blood vessels, making it easier for blood to flow and lowering blood pressure. It also eases urinary flow by relaxing muscles around the bladder and prostate.

Mechanism of Action of GENTROL 2.5 TABLET

GENTROL 2.5 TABLET contains prazosin, an alpha-1 adrenergic receptor blocker. It inhibits these receptors found in vascular smooth muscle, reducing the narrowing of blood vessels. This blockade reduces peripheral vascular resistance, supporting controlled blood pressure and better circulation.

Role of Alpha-1 Adrenergic Receptor Blockade

The alpha-1 receptor blockade stops catecholamines (like norepinephrine) from causing blood vessels to constrict. This action relaxes the vessel walls, reduces vascular resistance, and helps in lowering blood pressure. It also relaxes muscles in the prostate and bladder region.

Effects of GENTROL 2.5 TABLET on Blood Vessel Relaxation

By relaxing blood vessel muscles, GENTROL 2.5 TABLET causes vasodilation, which reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood. This dilation supports improved blood flow and helps maintain balanced blood pressure levels throughout the body.

How GENTROL 2.5 TABLET Supports Blood Flow and Pressure Control

GENTROL 2.5 TABLET facilitates easier blood movement by widening blood vessels and lowering resistance. It reduces workload on the heart while improving organ perfusion. This supports effective management of hypertension, heart failure, and symptoms of an enlarged prostate.

Pharmacodynamics and Safe Use of GENTROL 2.5 TABLET

Pharmacodynamically, GENTROL 2.5 TABLET lowers blood pressure without causing a rapid heart rate increase. It is metabolized by the liver and has an onset of action within 30 to 90 minutes. With regular medical supervision, it safely supports cardiovascular health while improving urinary comfort.
usageDetails:
How to use GENTROL 2.5 TABLET
How to Use GENTROL 2.5 TABLET Safely

Take GENTROL 2.5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water, with or without food, and do not crush or chew. Following your doctor's instructions ensures optimal absorption and effectiveness.

Recommended Dosage and Administration

The usual starting dose is 2.5 mg once daily. Depending on your response, the dose may be gradually increased by your doctor up to 20 mg daily in divided doses. Dosage adjustments are personalized based on blood pressure control and tolerance.

Best Time to Take GENTROL 2.5 TABLET

It is best to take GENTROL 2.5 TABLET at the same time each day, preferably after meals, to maintain consistent blood levels and reduce the chance of low blood pressure episodes.

Important Directions for GENTROL 2.5 TABLET Use

Do not stop taking GENTROL 2.5 TABLET suddenly, as this can cause a rapid increase in blood pressure. Inform your doctor of all medications you are taking and any pre-existing health conditions before starting therapy.

Dosage Adjustments and Monitoring

Your doctor will monitor your blood pressure regularly and may adjust the dose if needed. Inform your healthcare provider about any side effects, especially dizziness or light headedness, which may occur when standing up quickly.

Safety Tips During GENTROL 2.5 TABLET Therapy

Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery if you experience dizziness or drowsiness. Stay hydrated and rise slowly from sitting or lying positions to minimize light headedness. Report any persistent side effects to your doctor.

warnings.details: GENTROL 2.5 TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.
GENTROL 2.5 TABLET can pass into breast milk in small amounts. Breastfeeding mothers should use this medicine with caution. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Avoid driving or operating machinery if you feel dizziness, drowsiness, or weakness after taking GENTROL 2.5 TABLET
Do not consume alcohol while on GENTROL 2.5 TABLET, as it may increase dizziness, light-headedness, or a risk of fainting.
GENTROL 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking.
GENTROL 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking.
Do not take GENTROL 2.5 TABLET if you are allergic to Prazosin or any other quinazoline medicines like doxazosin or terazosin.

Patients with heart conditions such as heart failure, previous heart attack, or valve problems should take GENTROL 2.5 TABLET cautiously. Long-term use in such cases may cause fluid retention or swelling in legs and ankles. Consult your doctor before taking.
GENTROL 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for children under 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.
GENTROL 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients usually initiating the management with the lowest possible dose. Consult your doctor before taking it.
